title: Kissed with Yuzu-Kosho Canadian Beef Bake
description: Jammy, shattering, midnight-craving Canadian dish featuring yuzu-kosho, caramelized flavors, served on a talavera plate.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the beef short ribs with salt and pepper.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Sear the beef short ribs until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Remove the beef from the pot and set it aside.
Add the yuzu-kosho, honey, and balsamic vinegar to the pot, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Return the beef to the pot and add the thyme sprigs.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2.5 hours, or until the beef is tender and caramelized.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Serve the beef short ribs on a talavera plate, spooning the sauce over the top.
